## 420. The loss read in time by the others, joined to the critical mass (MA4b)

MA4 (§414) joined the capacity to shape the rule with the readers drawn from the selected. With the rule read from the share alone, every course from a start under the rule read there is locked one way or the other (`drawn_locked_either`). So control not selected does not by itself give a lock left in time: leaving needs a reading beyond the share. MA2 (§401) gave one: the others among the readers read a loss once it reaches a bound (`ClosedCapture.Thinned`). It was not joined to MA4's critical mass. MA4b joins them. It is step 7 of AJ's plan and states the joint selection's second condition, a lock left in time, in this model. It serves the alignment account (07 §6, its owner) and AJ4's dossier, which must say when a reading beyond the share is in time and what it presupposes.

**What was built.** A new leaf module, `Becoming.ReadInTime`. It builds on `Becoming.DrawnShaping` and, through it, on `Becoming.ClosedCapture`, `Becoming.RuleShaping`, `Becoming.RuleCapture`, `Becoming.Recurrence` (`Law.orbit`) and `Becoming.Resolution` (`powers`, `bernoulli_powers`), and changes none of them. It is a leaf: nothing below needs it.

**The review.** One independent read-only review by a separate AI agent (`REVIEW-MA4b.md` in the kit, with its probe module and the scripts of its integer mirror beside it) rebuilt the draft (`b69dfcb1e`), found no unsound Lean and fifteen findings in the text, and all were taken (the kit note's §8). The main one: a reading from the one step between is not always one step too late. In the review's probe P1 the course read from there is turned for good, and in its numeric survey of 50,342 such courses 15.2% were turned and 84.8% relocked; so the module now says the course starts a new round there, and it witnesses both outcomes. The other findings restored premises the text had dropped (the readings at N and N + 1, `Accrues`, `lo' ≤ hi`, the reading step), named ties, corrected "linear" to quadratic for the deadline, and gave the standing its two horns and its credits. Three premises shown unneeded were dropped: `c < hi` from the deadline, `lo' ≤ hi` and the start favoured from the bound on steps between, and the start favoured past the least reading. Five names changed.
